bio: The daughter Laetitia warmly welcomes guests to this family business, whose terrace overlooks the lush green countryside of the village of Lieferinge. Dad, mijnheer Van Holder, demonstrates his technical precision and eye for detail in dishes served in several plates. From a new spin on traditional flammkuchen to veal jazzed up with a punchy medley of international accents, the food is surprisingly complex and fascinating. Don’t forget to book!...
